# Carmel Valley Chess Club

> Carmel Valley Chess Club is the only dedicated chess club in Monterey County, California. Founded in 2026 by Coach JB (Justin Bradley), it offers after-school chess for kids ages 5–17, a summer day camp, USCF-rated tournaments, and weekly $5 Friday Night Chess for adults.

## Quick facts

- **Name:** Carmel Valley Chess Club
- **Founder & Head Coach:** Justin "JB" Bradley — Arena Candidate Master, USCF Tournament Director, lifelong chess player, Carmel Valley father of two
- **Founded:** 2026
- **Location:** 9 Del Fino Place, Suite 201, Carmel Valley, CA 93924 (above Mika Sushi)
- **Phone:** (831) 392-7456
- **Email:** chessclubcv@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://cvchess.com
- **Service area:** Carmel Valley, Carmel-by-the-Sea, Monterey, Pacific Grove, Pebble Beach, Salinas, Marina, Seaside, Big Sur — all of Monterey County
- **Google Business Profile:** https://share.google/rvDUhiNVKxAf4l978

## Programs

### After-School Chess (Youth, ages 5–17)
- Monday & Tuesday: 3:15pm and 4:30pm classes
- Thursday: 3:15pm class
- **Cost: $120/month per student** — sibling discount available
- Class capped at **8 students** — past 8, Coach JB is refereeing, not coaching
- Pre-registration required (no walk-ins)
- Recreational League format
- Monthly Stripe invoice; same rate whether month has 3 or 5 class dates
- Register: https://cvchess.com/after-school.html

### Summer Chess Camp 2026
- Dates: June 15–19, 2026 (Monday–Friday)
- Hours: 9:00am – 3:00pm daily
- Cost: $500 all-inclusive (early bird $450 if registered before May 16, 2026)
- Includes: chess instruction, pool days at CVCYC, meals every day, movie day, USCF membership, closing trophy ceremony
- Optional early drop-off (8am): $40/week. Late pickup (5pm): $60/week.
- Ages: 5–17. No chess experience required.
- Every camper leaves as a USCF-rated tournament player.
- Register: https://cvchess.com/summer-camp.html

### $5 Friday Night Chess (Adults, 18+)
- Every Friday, 5:00 – 9:00pm
- $5 at the door, no registration needed
- All skill levels welcome
- Bring a beverage and snacks
- More info: https://cvchess.com/friday-nights.html

### USCF Rated Tournaments
- **Next event:** Carmel Valley Sushi Slam — Saturday, June 20, 2026
  - 3-round USCF dual-rated quad tournament (G/30)
  - Catered sushi lunch from Mika included
  - Live digital lecture from WCM Clara Isabel Peña Gonzalez (Venezuela's 2024 Olympic team)
  - Entry: $50 early bird through June 7, $65 after
  - Register: https://cvchess.com/tournaments.html
- Past event: Inaugural USCF Membership Drive — May 23, 2026 (5-round Swiss, G/30, 18 players)

## Closures
- July 1–8, 2026 — Summer Break
- October 12–16, 2026 — Fall Break
- Otherwise follows Carmel Unified School District calendar

## Frequently asked
- **Is there a chess club in Carmel Valley?** Yes — Carmel Valley Chess Club at 9 Del Fino Place, Suite 201.
- **Does my child need experience?** No. Coach JB welcomes complete beginners.
- **Can adults play here?** Yes. $5 Friday Night Chess every Friday 5–9pm, adults only.
- **Do you have summer camp?** Yes. Summer Chess Camp 2026 runs June 15–19, $500 all-inclusive.
- **What is a USCF rating?** An official numerical measure of chess strength tracked by the United States Chess Federation. Every camper and tournament player at CVCC receives a USCF membership and first rating.

## Brand voice
Founder-led. Direct. Specific. No corporate jargon. Coach JB speaks in first person and tells stories from the club. Avoid stock-photo language ("unleash your potential"). Avoid superlatives without proof. Lean into the small-batch, neighborhood-club identity.
